v.s: By the night when it covers
v.c: By the night when it covers,

q: By the day when it illuminates
v.s: And [by] the day when it appears
v.c: and the day when it shines!

q: By the One Who created male and female!
v.s: And [by] He who created the male and female,
v.c: And by ˹the One˺ Who created male and female!

q: (while some people strive for the material possessions of this world, others strive for the Aakhirah).
v.s: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.
v.c: Surely the ends you strive for are diverse.

v.s: As for he who gives and fears God
v.c: As for the one who is charitable, mindful ˹of Allah˺,

v.s: And believes in the best [reward],
v.c: and ˹firmly˺ believes in the finest reward,

v.s: We will ease him toward ease.
v.c: We will facilitate for them the Way of Ease.

m: and considers himself free from need
q: As for the one who is miserly and indifferent
v.s: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
v.c: And as for the one who is stingy, indifferent ˹to Allah˺,

v.s: And denies the best [reward],
v.c: and ˹staunchly˺ denies the finest reward,

v.s: We will ease him toward difficulty.
v.c: We will facilitate for them the path of hardship.

q: His wealth will not benefit him when he falls
v.s: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
v.c: And their wealth will be of no benefit to them when they tumble ˹into Hell˺.

q: (leading a person to the straight path)
(because people can only indicate to others the straight path and they cannot compel them to take it)...
v.s: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.
v.c: It is certainly upon Us ˹alone˺ to show ˹the way to˺ guidance.
v.h: Reward of the Righteous and the Wicked

q: ...and the Aakhirah and the world are in Our control.
(We therefore have free reign to do as We please and people should obey Our commands.)
v.s: And indeed, to us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
v.c: And surely to Us ˹alone˺ belong this life and the next.

q: I have warned you about a raging fire
v.s: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
v.c: And so I have warned you of a raging Fire,

q: ...which only the most wretched shall enter...
v.s: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one
v.c: in which none will burn except the most wretched —

v.s: Who had denied and turned away.
v.c: who deny and turn away.

m: But will be removed from it
q: shall be the ones with the most Taqwa
v.s: But the righteous one will avoid it
v.c: But the righteous will be spared from it —

q: (their soul from greed and from other sins by attaining Allaah's pleasure and His forgiveness).
v.s: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
v.c: who donate ˹some of˺ their wealth only to purify themselves,

q: (to spend in charity because they need)
to repay a favour to anyone...
v.s: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
v.c: not in return for someone’s favours,

q: ...(but they spend for no after reason)
except for the pleasure of their Exalted Rabb.
(Their good deeds are therefore done since rely for Allaah's pleasure and not for ulterior motives.)
v.s: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
v.c: but seeking the pleasure of their Lord, the Most High.

q: (when Allaah rewards them in full in the Aakhirah).
v.s: And he is going to be satisfied.
v.c: They will certainly be pleased.
